name: caltech101
description: Caltech101 is a classic image classification benchmark containing images from 101 object categories (plus a background class). It measures a model's ability to perform single-label object recognition across varied pictorial instances and viewpoints. The dataset is commonly used to evaluate visual feature learning and generalization on relatively small, curated category sets.
reputation: A widely used, classic computer vision benchmark for object recognition—popular historically for feature learning and transfer experiments but less central for modern large-scale evaluation.
